detail: Published at the IEEE National Conference on Computing, Communication & Technology (CCT-2010) at RVCE. Combined academic rigor with industry application from the start of career.

detail: Proficient across more than 25 languages over 20 years — Java, Python, TypeScript, Go, Kotlin, Swift, Rust, Scala, C++, Ruby, and more. A polyglot who picks the right tool for the job.

detail: IBM (2007–2014), Exeter Group (2014–2018), Amazon (2018), Philips (2018–present). From individual contributor to Principal. From writing code to transforming organizations. Every role left a measurable mark.

detail: Led book distribution sessions since 2012, reaching 10,000+ children in rural areas around Mysore by 2018. A six-year sustained program distributing books, stationery, and educational materials to underserved communities.

detail: Active volunteer since 2007 across multiple organizations: SuDhee (underprivileged children's education), Bala Samskara Shibira (values camps), Hindu Seva Pratishtana (Yogashree), Mentor Together, and rural school programs. Never stopped giving back.

label: Talks at colleges and schools
detail: Delivered 30+ guest lectures and workshops at engineering colleges and schools across India — covering design patterns, SOLID principles, microservices, career guidance, and personality development. Audiences from 30 to 100+ students per session.

detail: Certified Yoga trainer from SVYASA (Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana). Conducts corporate and community wellness sessions. Taught yoga to children at community halls, combining physical wellness with values education.

label: Teaching AI to young minds
detail: In 2026, volunteered to teach 3rd graders about AI integration — interviewing fictional characters like Dr. Seuss and Dogman using AI models. Making cutting-edge technology accessible and fun for the youngest learners.

label: School uniform program since 2016
detail: Contributing to and participating in a uniform distribution program for underprivileged children since 2016 — ensuring kids can attend school with dignity. Part of a broader commitment to removing barriers to education.

label: Storytelling for character building
detail: Conducts regular storytelling and personality development sessions drawing from Indian epics (Ramayana & Mahabharata) at community centers, rural schools, and children's camps. Using ancient wisdom to build modern character.
